witness_description: On V={0,...,10}, let G have all 10 edges within {0,...,4} and all 9 edges between {5,6,7} and {8,9,10}, with no other edges. Then G contains K5, while its complement contains K3,3 between {0,1,2} and {5,6,7}. Moreover, |E(G)|=19 and |E(complement)|=36.
refutation_explanation: Both G and its complement are nonplanar: the former contains K5, and the latter contains K3,3. Nevertheless, |E(G)|+|E(complement)|=19+36=55>54, directly violating the asserted inequality.
search_space: All 4,620 labeled simple graphs on vertex set {0,...,10} that are disjoint unions of a K5 and a K3,3, enumerated by every 5-subset A and every unordered 3+3 partition of its six-vertex complement. The entire family is swept in lexicographic order.
